Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding sales of used law enforcement motor vehicles.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to sales or exchanges of used law enforcementvehicles; and adding a new section to chapter 43.19 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.19 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Neither the state nor any of its political subdivisions maysell or exchange motor vehicles that have been used for law enforcementpurposes before removing all equipment added to or in or on the motorvehicle that is in addition to equipment customarily in or on a motorvehicle purchased for ordinary consumer use. (2) Subsection (1) of this section does not apply if a motorvehicle is sold or exchanged to be used for law enforcement purposes tothe state or its political subdivisions.
